prompt: Earth is nearest the Sun in January. Why is it still winter then in the Northern Hemisphere?
options: Axial tilt changes sun angle and daylight more than the small distance change
The Northern Hemisphere is tilted away from the Sun, shortening its days
Earth's atmosphere is farther from the Sun during January
Ocean currents prevent the north from retaining summer heat
explanation: Earth's axial tilt is the main cause of the seasons; it changes daylight length and the angle of incoming sunlight.

prompt: The Moon rotates once in about the same time it orbits Earth. What does this explain?
options: Nearly the same lunar hemisphere faces Earth throughout the month
The Moon's far side never receives sunlight
The Moon remains above the same point on Earth's surface
The Moon's phases are caused by its rotation
explanation: Synchronous rotation keeps the Moon's rotation period equal to its orbital period, so the same side faces Earth.

prompt: Lamu Old Town is especially known as a well-preserved example of which settlement tradition?
options: Swahili coastal settlement
Great Lakes fishing village
Southern African mining town
Nile Valley farming settlement
explanation: UNESCO describes Lamu as the oldest and best-preserved example of a Swahili settlement in East Africa.

prompt: In which year was the First Folio, the first collected edition of Shakespeare's plays, published?
explanation: The First Folio was published in 1623, seven years after Shakespeare's death.

prompt: Which painting's title helped give Impressionism its name?
options: Claude Monet's Impression, Sunrise
Edgar Degas's The Dance Class
Camille Pissarro's Boulevard Montmartre
Pierre-Auguste Renoir's The Swing
explanation: A critic used the word impression after seeing Monet's Impression, Sunrise at the 1874 exhibition.

prompt: What does a pointillist painter rely on viewers to do when looking at many small dots of color?
options: Visually blend the separate marks at a distance
Interpret each color as a fixed symbol in a visual code
Trace a continuous outline hidden between the marks
See the pigments chemically merge after the paint dries
explanation: Pointillist artists placed small marks of color so that they combine perceptually when viewed from a distance.

prompt: A score marks a passage crescendo. What change should a performer make?
options: Increase the volume gradually
Increase the tempo gradually
Gradually move the melody into a higher register
Make each note shorter and more detached
explanation: Crescendo is a gradual increase in loudness, or musical dynamics.

prompt: Great Zimbabwe is most recognized for which kind of historic remains?
options: Large dry-stone enclosures and walls
A coral-stone port with carved Swahili doorways
A terraced city built from fired-brick stupas
A royal complex of stepped mud-brick pyramids
explanation: The Great Zimbabwe ruins include monumental walls built from carefully fitted stone without mortar.

prompt: Why can a healthy mangrove belt reduce damage to a tropical shoreline during storms?
options: Its roots slow waves and help hold sediment in place
Its canopy absorbs most of the energy in storm winds
Its roots draw seawater away from the shore at high tide
Its trunks prevent storm surges from entering tidal channels
explanation: Mangrove roots reduce wave energy and trap sediment, helping stabilize some shorelines.

prompt: A fair six-sided die is rolled twice. What is the chance of getting a six on both rolls?
options: 1 in 36
1 in 12
1 in 6
2 in 6
explanation: The independent probabilities multiply: one-sixth times one-sixth equals one-thirty-sixth.

prompt: Two notes have the same loudness but different pitch. Which property of their sound waves differs most directly?
options: Frequency
Amplitude
Travel distance
Duration
explanation: For a periodic sound, frequency is perceived primarily as pitch; amplitude relates more directly to loudness.

prompt: The internationally agreed zero-degree longitude line passes through which historic observatory?
options: The Royal Observatory at Greenwich
The Paris Observatory at Meudon
The Cape of Good Hope Observatory
The Berlin Observatory at Potsdam
explanation: The Prime Meridian is defined at zero longitude through the historic Airy Transit Circle at Greenwich.

prompt: The East African Rift is widening in places. Which tectonic process best accounts for this?
options: The African Plate is being pulled into diverging plate systems
The African Plate is sliding beneath the Eurasian Plate
The Somali coast is moving toward the Earth's axis
Oceanic crust is being pushed west beneath the Congo Basin
explanation: The East African Rift is an active continental rift where the Nubian and Somali parts of the African Plate are diverging.

prompt: During El Niño, which change helps warm surface water spread eastward across the equatorial Pacific?
options: The usual east-to-west trade winds weaken
The usual east-to-west trade winds strengthen
The trade winds shift south while keeping their strength
The equatorial Pacific westerlies weaken and cool the east
explanation: Weakened Pacific trade winds allow warm surface water to shift back toward the Americas and reduce upwelling.

prompt: Wakati wa El Niño, mabadiliko gani ya upepo wa pasati husaidia maji ya joto kusogea mashariki mwa Pasifiki? (Which trade-wind change helps warm water move east?)
options: Upepo wa kawaida wa mashariki kwenda magharibi hudhoofika
Upepo wa magharibi kwenda mashariki huimarika juu ya Atlantiki
Upepo wa nchi kavu husimama katika dunia yote
Upepo wa kaskazini hugeuka kuwa upepo wa kusini
explanation: El Niño huhusishwa na kudhoofika kwa upepo wa pasati wa Pasifiki, jambo linaloruhusu maji ya joto kusogea mashariki.

prompt: Why is the First Folio considered especially important to the survival of Shakespeare's plays?
options: It printed eighteen plays that had not appeared in print before
It was the only book Shakespeare published while alive
It included the original manuscripts in Shakespeare's handwriting
It was the first English book printed with movable type
explanation: Eighteen plays were first printed in the 1623 First Folio and might otherwise have been lost.

prompt: Which technique helped Impressionist painters suggest changing light without outlining every object sharply?
options: Short, broken brushstrokes and colored shadows
Smooth tonal modeling with softened edges
Strong contour lines filled with unmixed local colors
Layered glazes that blend colors on the canvas
explanation: The Met describes short broken strokes, bright color, and colored shadows as features of Impressionist practice.

prompt: Historia ya Lamu inaonyesha mwingiliano wa jamii zipi katika pwani ya Afrika Mashariki? (Which communities interacted in Lamu's coastal history?)
options: Jamii za Kibantu, Waarabu, Waajemi, Wahindi na Wazungu
Wavikingi, Wamongolia, Wamaya na Wainka
Wagiriki, Wavikingi, Wajapani na Waazteki
Waberberu, Wacelt, Wamaya na Wainka
explanation: UNESCO inaeleza Lamu kama mahali ambapo mwingiliano wa jamii za Kiafrika, Kiarabu, Kiajemi, Kihindi na Ulaya ulijenga utamaduni wa Waswahili.

prompt: A coastal gauge shows a smaller tidal range near first-quarter Moon. What is the best explanation?
options: Solar and lunar tidal effects act at roughly right angles and partly offset
The Moon's gravity temporarily disappears at quarter phase
The Sun and Moon are aligned on opposite sides of Earth
Earth's rotation slows enough to reduce ocean levels
explanation: Around quarter phases, the Sun and Moon pull in different directions, producing neap tides with a smaller range.

prompt: A bass line repeats the same short pattern under changing melodies. What musical role is it most likely serving?
options: An ostinato
A cadenza
A recitative
A fermata
explanation: An ostinato is a persistently repeated musical pattern, often supporting changing material above it.

prompt: Kwa nini tunaona karibu upande uleule wa Mwezi kila wakati? (Why do we see nearly the same side of the Moon?)
options: Mwezi huzunguka kwenye mhimili wake kwa muda unaolingana na mzunguko wake kuizunguka Dunia
Mwezi hausogei kwenye mhimili wake
Dunia huzunguka mara moja tu kila mwezi
Mwangaza wa Jua huficha upande wa mbali wa Mwezi
explanation: Mzunguko wa Mwezi kwenye mhimili wake na muda wa kuizunguka Dunia ni karibu sawa, hivyo upande mmoja hutuelekea.

prompt: Two equal storms hit similar catchments. One has steep slopes and paved surfaces; the other has permeable soil and vegetation. Which is more likely to peak sooner?
options: The paved catchment, because more water reaches channels quickly
The vegetated catchment, because infiltration returns water to streams faster
Both catchments, because equal rainfall fixes the time to peak
A paved catchment, because sealed ground routes runoff to channels faster
explanation: Impervious surfaces and steep slopes tend to speed runoff and shorten travel time to streams.

prompt: UNESCO describes Lamu's built environment as a fusion of outside influences with which local tradition?
options: Traditional Swahili building techniques
Inca stone-cutting methods
Mughal garden planning
Nordic timber construction
explanation: Lamu's architecture shows influences from Europe, Arabia, and India combined with traditional Swahili techniques.

prompt: A map scale says 1 cm represents 8 km. Two towns are 5.5 cm apart on the map. What is their straight-line distance?
options: 44 km
40 km
55 km
explanation: Multiply the map distance by the scale: 5.5 times 8 equals 44 kilometres.

prompt: The First Folio grouped Shakespeare's plays under which three headings?
options: Comedies, histories, and tragedies
Poems, novels, and essays
Pastorals, satires, and epics
Myths, fables, and chronicles
explanation: The First Folio's title and organization divide the plays into comedies, histories, and tragedies.

prompt: The Moon orbits Earth in about 27.3 days, but its phase cycle takes about 29.5 days. Why are the periods different?
options: Earth moves along its orbit while the Moon completes one orbit, so it needs extra time to realign with the Sun
The Moon changes orbital direction halfway through each cycle
Earth's rotation adds two full days to every lunar orbit
The Moon's orbit expands by a fixed amount every month
explanation: After one sidereal orbit, Earth has moved around the Sun, so the Moon needs additional time to return to the same Sun-Earth geometry.

prompt: Why can reduced upwelling off western South America affect fish populations during El Niño?
options: Less nutrient-rich deep water reaches the surface, reducing food for plankton
The deep water becomes more oxygen-rich and drives all fish offshore
Warmer water prevents sunlight from entering the ocean
Trade winds carry adult fish eastward into rivers
explanation: El Niño weakens upwelling that normally brings cold, nutrient-rich water to the surface, reducing plankton productivity.

prompt: Bonde la Ufa la Afrika Mashariki linapanuka kwa sababu gani ya kitektoniki? (What tectonic process is widening the East African Rift?)
options: Sehemu za Bamba la Afrika zinatengana
Bamba la Afrika linazama chini ya Bamba la Eurasia
Bamba la Arabia linasukuma Afrika kuelekea kusini
Ukoko wote wa Afrika unazunguka kuelekea mashariki kwa kasi sawa
explanation: Bonde la Ufa linahusishwa na sehemu za Bamba la Afrika zinazovutana na kutengana.

prompt: An Impressionist paints a shadow with blue and violet rather than black. What idea does this reflect?
options: Shadows can contain reflected and ambient color, not simply black
The artist is using the traditional monochrome underpainting as the final layer
Blue pigment makes a shadow physically darker in every lighting condition
Impressionists avoided observing objects outdoors
explanation: Impressionists often used color in shadows and highlights to represent changing light and atmosphere.

prompt: A melody repeatedly accents weak beats or offbeats. Which rhythmic effect is being used?
options: Syncopation
Rubato
Ostinato
Counterpoint
explanation: Syncopation places emphasis where a listener may not expect it, such as weak beats or offbeats.

prompt: Rain stops, yet a stream continues to rise for several hours. Which watershed explanation is strongest?
options: Runoff and subsurface water are still travelling through the basin toward the gauge
The stream creates new rainfall after the storm ends
The gauge must be recording the Moon's gravitational pull
Water cannot enter a stream after rainfall stops
explanation: Water takes time to move across land and through soil and tributaries, so stream response can lag behind rainfall.

prompt: Why was a folio-format book generally more expensive to produce than a small quarto in Shakespeare's period?
options: It used larger sheets folded fewer times, producing larger pages
It required a separate handwritten copy for each buyer
It was printed only on imported parchment
It contained twice as many plays by definition
explanation: A folio sheet was folded once to create four pages; the larger format was more prestigious and costly than a quarto.

prompt: Kitabu cha First Folio ni muhimu kwa kazi za Shakespeare kwa sababu gani? (Why is the First Folio important to Shakespeare's works?)
options: Kiliweka pamoja tamthilia ambazo baadhi hazikuwa zimechapishwa awali
Kilikuwa daftari pekee aliloandika Shakespeare mwenyewe
Kiliandikwa kabla ya Shakespeare kufika London
Kilikuwa tafsiri ya kwanza ya tamthilia zake kutoka Kilatini
explanation: First Folio ya 1623 ilichapisha tamthilia 18 ambazo hazikuwa zimeonekana katika chapa hapo awali.

prompt: A fair coin is tossed three times. What is the probability of getting at least one head?
explanation: The complement is three tails, with probability 1/8; therefore at least one head has probability 1 minus 1/8, or 7/8.

prompt: Wasanii wa Impressionism walitumia nini kuonyesha mabadiliko ya mwanga? (What did Impressionists use to show changing light?)
options: Mikwaruzo mifupi ya rangi na vivuli vyenye rangi tofauti
Mistari myeusi iliyofungwa kuzunguka kila kitu
Rangi moja tambarare kwa picha nzima
Michoro ya kijiometri isiyobadilika kwa kila kazi
explanation: Michoro ya Impressionism mara nyingi hutumia mikwaruzo huru na rangi kuonyesha athari ya mwanga.

prompt: A student spends Saturday studying instead of taking a paid shift. In economic terms, what is the opportunity cost of studying?
options: The value of the best alternative given up, such as the shift's pay
The total price of every activity available that day
Only the money already spent on textbooks
The amount of time the student spends sleeping
explanation: Opportunity cost is the value of the next-best alternative that is forgone when making a choice.

prompt: Mizizi ya mikoko inaweza kusaidiaje pwani wakati wa mawimbi makubwa? (How can mangrove roots help a coast during large waves?)
options: Hupunguza nguvu ya mawimbi na kushikilia mashapo
Huzuia mawimbi yote kuingia baharini
Hubadilisha maji ya chumvi kuwa maji safi
Husimamisha upepo juu ya bahari
explanation: Mizizi ya mikoko inaweza kupunguza nguvu ya mawimbi na kunasa mashapo, ingawa kinga hutegemea hali ya eneo.

prompt: A pointillist canvas looks fragmented up close but unified from across the room. What accounts for the change?
options: The viewer's eye optically combines nearby marks into larger color areas
The paint chemically changes color as the viewer moves away
A hidden varnish fills the gaps between the dots
The artist paints a second image on the back of the canvas
explanation: Pointillism uses small separate marks whose colors visually blend at normal viewing distance.

prompt: Compared with normal Pacific conditions, what tends to happen to trade winds and upwelling during La Niña?
options: Trade winds strengthen and upwelling increases off South America
Trade winds weaken and upwelling stops throughout the Pacific
Winds reverse permanently and upwelling shifts to the Indian Ocean
Trade winds stop while deep water warms the eastern Pacific
explanation: La Niña strengthens the normal trade winds, pushing warm surface water west and enhancing cold-water upwelling in the east.

prompt: El Niño ikipunguza maji baridi yenye virutubisho yanayopanda juu ya bahari, nini kinaweza kutokea kwa planktoni? (What may happen to plankton?)
options: Virutubisho vinapungua na uzalishaji wa planktoni unaweza kushuka
Planktoni zote hugeuka kuwa samaki wakubwa
Maji ya kina hujaa oksijeni na kuongeza chakula moja kwa moja
Planktoni huhamia kwenye mito kwa sababu ya upepo
explanation: Upwelling inapopungua, virutubisho vichache hufika juu na planktoni zinaweza kupungua.

prompt: In a swung rhythm, paired eighth notes are commonly performed how?
options: With an uneven long-short feel rather than as equal halves
As two notes that must always be simultaneous
At twice the written tempo with no accent
As a sustained note followed by a full bar of silence
explanation: Swing commonly gives paired subdivisions an uneven long-short feel, though the exact ratio varies by style and tempo.

prompt: Which materials are characteristic of many traditional buildings in Lamu Old Town?
options: Coral stone and mangrove timber
Granite blocks and cedar shingles
Adobe bricks and bamboo thatch
Marble columns and fired clay tiles
explanation: UNESCO notes Lamu's coral-stone buildings and mangrove timber construction.

prompt: Ni sifa gani ya usanifu inayotambulisha magofu ya Great Zimbabwe? (Which architectural feature identifies Great Zimbabwe?)
options: Kuta kubwa za mawe zilizojengwa bila chokaa
Madaraja ya chuma yaliyotengenezwa na Warumi
Minara ya mbao iliyopakwa porcelaini
Mapiramidi ya matofali ya udongo yaliyofunikwa kwa marumaru
explanation: Great Zimbabwe inajulikana kwa kuta za mawe makavu zilizowekwa kwa ustadi bila chokaa.

prompt: Why is totality during a total solar eclipse limited to a narrow path across Earth?
options: The Moon's darkest central shadow covers only a small area at Earth's distance
Earth's atmosphere absorbs the Moon's shadow outside the path
The Moon blocks sunlight only for observers near the equator
Earth's rotation stretches the Moon's shadow into a narrow line
explanation: The Moon's umbra reaches a relatively small region of Earth's surface, while nearby areas see a partial eclipse.

prompt: If the First Folio had not been compiled, what is the most defensible concern about Shakespeare's surviving works?
options: Eighteen plays might have been lost because they had not been printed earlier
All of his sonnets would have vanished from manuscript collections
His plays would never have been performed in public
No English plays could have been printed before 1700
explanation: The Folger notes that eighteen plays first appeared in print in the First Folio and might otherwise have been lost.

prompt: What did Monet's Impression, Sunrise contribute to the later name of the Impressionist movement?
options: A critic used its title to describe the works as impressions rather than finished pictures
Monet titled it after the first official Impressionist salon
The painting introduced the first use of oil paint outdoors
Its sunrise subject became a required theme for movement members
explanation: Critic Louis Leroy used Monet's title in a review of the 1874 independent exhibition, helping establish the movement's label.

prompt: Why is a lunar phase cycle longer than the Moon's orbit measured against distant stars?
options: Earth has moved around the Sun, so the Moon must travel farther to repeat the same alignment
The Moon slows its orbital speed at every full Moon
The Sun's gravity pauses the Moon for two days each month
Earth's rotation adds a complete orbit to the lunar month
explanation: The Moon must move beyond one sidereal orbit to regain the same Sun-Earth-Moon geometry because Earth also moves around the Sun.

prompt: Which combination best explains why Lamu's historic architecture reflects both its coastal setting and Indian Ocean connections?
options: Local Swahili building methods combined with influences from Arabia, India, and Europe
Inland stone traditions combined only with Central African trade
Colonial railway planning combined with Arctic timber construction
A single imported style replaced all local building practices
explanation: UNESCO describes Lamu's architecture as a distinctive Swahili tradition shaped by European, Arabian, and Indian influences.

prompt: A song in a major key briefly uses a chord borrowed from its parallel minor. What is the listener most likely to hear?
options: A color change that briefly darkens the harmony without changing the tonic
A permanent change of tempo with no change in harmony
A modulation that must end in a different key
A shift from instrumental music to spoken recitation
explanation: Modal mixture borrows a chord from the parallel mode, adding a contrasting harmonic color while the home key can remain major.

prompt: A mangrove restoration project stabilizes a muddy shore. Which mechanism best links roots to that result?
options: Roots slow water and trap suspended sediment that can build the shoreline
Roots dissolve salt and make the seabed denser
Roots force tides to occur less often
Roots transfer offshore sand directly into inland rivers
explanation: Mangrove root systems reduce flow energy and trap sediment, helping stabilize coastal areas.

prompt: Ni maelezo gani yanayofaa zaidi kuhusu usanifu wa Lamu Old Town? (Which description best fits Lamu Old Town's architecture?)
options: Mbinu za Waswahili zimechanganyika na athari za Arabia, India na Ulaya
Majengo yote yanafuata mtindo mmoja ulioletwa kutoka Ulaya
Mji ulijengwa bila kuathiriwa na biashara ya baharini
Usanifu wake ulitokana hasa na hekalu za milimani za Asia ya Kati
explanation: UNESCO inaeleza usanifu wa Lamu kama utamaduni wa Waswahili ulioundwa na mwingiliano wa maeneo kadhaa ya biashara.

prompt: Kwa nini mzunguko wa awamu za Mwezi huchukua muda mrefu kuliko mzunguko wake kuizunguka Dunia mara moja? (Why is a phase cycle longer than one lunar orbit?)
options: Dunia husogea kuzunguka Jua, hivyo Mwezi lazima usafiri zaidi ili kurudia mpangilio uleule
Mwezi husimama kwa siku mbili kila baada ya mwezi mmoja
Mzunguko wa Mwezi hugeuka upande wa pili baada ya Mwezi mpevu
Jua huzuia Mwezi kukamilisha mzunguko wake kwa wiki moja
explanation: Dunia nayo husogea katika obiti yake, hivyo Mwezi huhitaji muda wa ziada ili kurudia mpangilio uleule wa Jua na Dunia.

prompt: Kwa nini jina la Impression, Sunrise lilihusishwa na Impressionism? (Why was Impression, Sunrise linked to Impressionism?)
options: Mkosoaji alitumia jina la mchoro kueleza kazi hizo kama 'taswira' badala ya picha zilizokamilika
Mchoro huo ulikuwa na sheria rasmi za shule ya sanaa ya Paris
Monet alitumia jina hilo kwa kila mchoro wa alfajiri
Jina hilo lilitokana na rangi maalumu iliyotengenezwa na Monet
explanation: Mkosoaji Louis Leroy alitumia jina la mchoro wa Monet katika maoni yake kuhusu maonyesho ya 1874.

prompt: Mikoko inaweza kusaidia kujenga ukingo wa matope kwa njia gani? (How can mangroves help build a muddy shoreline?)
options: Mizizi hupunguza kasi ya maji na kunasa mashapo yanayosafirishwa
Majani yake hubadilisha maji yote ya bahari kuwa mvua
Mizizi huzuia mawimbi na kuondoa mikondo ya bahari kabisa
Mikoko huhamisha mchanga kutoka mito hadi vilima
explanation: Mizizi ya mikoko hupunguza nguvu ya mtiririko na kunasa mashapo, ingawa matokeo hutegemea mazingira ya eneo.

prompt: First Folio ilichapishwa miaka saba baada ya kifo cha Shakespeare. Kwa nini hilo ni muhimu kwa historia ya tamthilia zake? (Why does this timing matter?)
options: Marafiki na wafanyakazi wenzake walikusanya tamthilia ambazo nyingi hazikuwa zimechapishwa pamoja
Shakespeare aliandika tamthilia zote akiwa hai ndani ya kitabu hicho
Kitabu hicho kilichapishwa kabla ya tamthilia zake kuigizwa
Wachapishaji walitafsiri tamthilia zake kutoka lugha ya Kigiriki
explanation: John Heminge na Henry Condell, waliokuwa wafanyakazi wenzake Shakespeare, walikusanya tamthilia katika toleo la 1623.

prompt: Upepo wa pasati unapodhoofika wakati wa El Niño, kwa nini samaki fulani wa pwani ya Amerika Kusini huathirika? (Why can some South American coastal fish be affected?)
options: Upwelling hupungua na kuleta virutubisho vichache vya kina juu ya bahari
Maji yote ya bahari hugeuka kuwa safi na kukosa chumvi
Mwezi huvuta samaki kutoka pwani hadi katikati ya Pasifiki
Mawimbi ya sauti huzuia samaki kula planktoni
explanation: Upwelling huleta maji baridi yenye virutubisho juu; inapopungua, planktoni na viumbe wanaotegemea chakula hicho huathirika.
